brief: Weekly Morgan Stanley sales commentary framing Q4 as a balanced bull/bear setup: earnings growth, broadening EPS breadth and early AI ROI signs support risk assets, against higher oil, higher rates and narrowing price-action breadth. The next move depends on whether earnings keep delivering or the discount rate starts to matter more. Meta Muse's #1 App Store ranking revived the agentic-commerce trade across Consumer, Travel, Software and Internet, with EXPE named Muse's first major OTA partner and BKNG, ABNB seen at risk of following suit. Economist Gapen expects two more 25bp Fed hikes to 4.25-4.50%, below the roughly 100bp markets price, as 5Y Treasury yields topped 5% for the first time since 2007. Brent trades above $100 and a possible US diesel export curtailment threatens gasoline supply, though Pelosky flags a potential US-Iran deal reopening the Strait of Hormuz as a catalyst for lower oil and yields. Strategist Wilson reads breadth narrowing beneath a resilient index (40%+ of Russell 3000 down 20%+ since June) while keeping his 8,000 S&P year-end target. The note also compiles dozens of standalone single-name and regional research calls with no unifying thesis beyond the intro framing.
